content.en: Inflation represents a **persistent rise** in the average price level. It is measured using indices like the **Consumer Price Index (CPI)** and **Wholesale Price Index (WPI)**. When the value of money decreases, the same amount of currency buys fewer goods, which is the hallmark of inflationary pressure.

content.en: Headline inflation includes all items in the basket, while Core inflation excludes volatile items like food and fuel.

content.en: Students often confuse inflation with a one-time price hike; remember that inflation must be a sustained increase.
